corrections: (d) 铅基准的归属被推翻。修正前:证词 2.6「Gotz et al. note that … The correlation of childhood lead exposure and adult IQ is r = .11」。修正后:Götz/Gosling/Rentfrow 原文根本没有铅-IQ 这个例子。其医学/教育基准清单逐字为:阿司匹林×预防心脏病 r=.03、钙摄入×绝经前女性 bone mass r=.08、布洛芬×镇痛 r=.14、心脏病人教育×运动 r=.09、成长型思维 r=.08、免费校餐 +.09 SD。全文(含参考文献)无 lead/铅字样。真正出处是 Meyer et al. 2001, American Psychologist 56:128–165, Table 1 第 18 项。

(d) 铅基准的数值与构念同时有误。修正前:r = .11,「childhood lead exposure and adult IQ」。修正后:Meyer 2001 Table 1 第18项原文为「Extent of low-level lead exposure and reduced childhood IQ (Needleman & Gatsonis, 1990)」,r = .12,N = 3,210;构念是「低水平(low-level)铅暴露 × 儿童期 IQ」,不是成人 IQ;且该 r 是偏相关(已校正父母 IQ 等影响 IQ 的基线特征),由血铅与牙铅两种测量加权得出。证词丢掉了「low-level」限定语,并把儿童期 IQ 改成了成人 IQ。

(d) 钙基准成立,仅构念用词需校准。修正前:待验论断把它记为「绝经前女性骨密度(bone mineral density)」。修正后:Götz 原文逐字为「calcium intake and bone mass in premenopausal women (r = .08; Meyer et al., 2001)」——构念是 bone mass(骨量)。数值 .08 与 Meyer Table 1 第10项(Welten, Kemper, Post & Van Staveren, 1995;N = 2,493)完全一致。此分项 HOLDS。

(d) 两项规范性推论不是 Götz 的话。修正前:证词写「r=.08 which is enough to recommend that women take calcium supplements」「r=.11 which is enough to justify a national campaign to remove lead from water supplies」。修正后:Götz 原文只说这些效应「small to minimal, according to Cohen's classic guidelines (1988), but still highly consequential from a public health perspective」,未提补钙建议,也未提除铅运动。(证词所引「effects that accumulate over time and at scale」确为 Götz 原文逐字。)

(a)「2 到 6 倍」的分子分母需重算。修正前:「the relationship is between 2 and 6 times larger than for 'social media' only vs 'digital media'」。修正后:按 O&P 2019 Table 2 中位 β 实算 = 1.75×(MCS:Hours of Social Media Use Only −.056 vs Complete SCA −.032)到 6.2×(MTF:Social Media Use Only −.031 vs Complete SCA −.005),下限低于 2。改用 partial η² 时 MCS 为 2.25×(.009/.004)。即「2–6 倍」须在 MCS 用 η²、在 MTF 用 β 才成立,混用了两种统计量单位。另:三个数据集中 YRBS 根本没有社媒测项(只有 Electronic Device Use −.071 与 TV Use −.012),该倍数只能来自 2 个数据集,非「in their own published report」整体。

(a) r ≈ .20 的口径被一手反证直接冲撞。修正前:证词 2.2 称 6 项分析选择「obscuring an association that is actually equivalent to a correlation coefficient of around r=.20」,行文读起来像是 O&P 总体关联的修正值。修正后:(i) O&P 在同刊 Reply 中按 Twenge 等人偏好的分析选择重跑规格曲线,得 median β = −0.051 [−0.072, −0.031],解释方差 0.3% [0.2, 0.6];女性 median β = −0.069 [−0.074, −0.065],男性 −0.037;并写道「Wearing glasses was still more negatively associated with well-being in adolescents than digital technology use (βglasses = − 0.061 vs βtechnology = − 0.051)」。|β| ≈ .05–.07,与 .20 差 3–4 倍。(ii) r=.20 与同一份证词 2.3 自述的「r=.10 到 r=.15,for both sexes combined」自相矛盾,只有落进 2.4 的女孩专项区间才勉强成立。(iii) 倍数放大不通向 .20:O&P 表中社媒专项最大中位 β 仅 −.056,6 倍于近零仍是近零。

(c) Orben 2020 引语逐字无误,但被截断且被选择性框定。修正前:证词 2.3 只引「The associations between social media use and well-being therefore range from about r = − 0.15 to r = − 0.10.」并称「I agree with this assessment」,小节标题写「emerging consensus … in the ballpark of r = .10 to r = .15」。修正后:引语逐字准确(SPPE 2020, 55:407–414, p.409, 'Systematic reviews and meta-analyses: social media' 节)。但紧接的下一句被略去:「It is, however, still unclear what such a small effect can tell us about well-being outcomes as social media use is inherently linked in complex ways with other aspects of life.」更关键的是 Orben 在自己的总结节(p.410,'Small negative associations between screens, social media and wellbeing')给同一区间时明确补充:「while the correlations fall to about r = − 0.10 to r = − 0.05 in some work lauded as being more transparent」。证词把 .10–.15 呈现为「共识」,略去了 Orben 本人指出的高透明度研究降至 .05–.10。

(b) 女孩 r=.15–.22 逐字完全成立,但出处需修正。修正前(隐含):该区间有被引一手研究支撑。修正后:证词 2.4 原文逐字为「A ballpark figure for the correlation just for girls is roughly r = .15 to r = .22.」——一字不差。但这是 Haidt 自陈的 ballpark figure,无推导;同段所引三项研究(Kelly, Zilanawala, Booker & Sacker 2019;Nesi & Prinstein 2015;Twenge 2020)是用来支撑「女孩大于男孩」的方向性判断(「I know of no study that has found a larger relationship for boys」),而非该 .15–.22 区间本身。该数值区间不出自任何被引一手研究。

利益相关口径:证词 2.2 用以反击 O&P 的「published response paper in the same journal」是 Haidt 本人合著(Twenge, Haidt, Joiner & Campbell 2020),即以自撰评论作为纠正 O&P 的权威依据;证词正文未见利益冲突或资助披露段落(grep disclos/conflict/funding/compensat/expert witness 均无命中)。
evidence_notes: 证词一手件已取得并逐字比对:Jonathan Haidt, 'Teen Mental Health Is Plummeting, and Social Media is a Major Contributing Cause', Testimony before the Senate Judiciary Committee, Subcommittee on Technology, Privacy, and the Law, May 4, 2022. https://www.judiciary.senate.gov/imo/media/doc/Haidt%20Testimony.pdf(PDF 经 pdftotext 提取;2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/2.6 全节已核)。

2.2 逐字:「…Orben and Przybylski made 6 analytical choices, each one defensible, that collectively ended up reducing the statistical relationship and obscuring an association that is actually equivalent to a correlation coefficient of around r=.20.」及「In their own published report, when you zoom in on "social media" only, the relationship is between 2 and 6 times larger than for "digital media".」——与待验论断一致(论断省略了「In their own published report,」)。
2.4 逐字:「A ballpark figure for the correlation just for girls is roughly r = .15 to r = .22.」——与待验论断完全一致。

2.3 逐字:「Her own conclusion is that "The associations between social media use and well-being therefore range from about r = − 0.15 to r = − 0.10." I agree with this assessment, for both sexes combined.」

Orben, A. (2020). Teenagers, screens and social media: a narrative review of reviews and key studies. Soc Psychiatry Psychiatr Epidemiol 55:407–414. 开放获取 PDF 已下载(https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s00127-019-01825-4.pdf)。p.409 原文逐字确认:「The associations between social media use and well-being therefore range from about r = − 0.15 to r = − 0.10. It is, however, still unclear what such a small effect can tell us about well-being outcomes as social media use is inherently linked in complex ways with other aspects of life.」卷期页码与论断所给一致。

Orben 2020 p.410 总结节原文逐字:「Many studies and meta-analyses find a small negative association between social media use and well-being of about r = − 0.15 to r = − 0.10, while the correlations fall to about r = − 0.10 to r = − 0.05 in some work lauded as being more transparent [42, 43].」——证词未引此限定句。同页 Orben 给出的组成数字为:社媒×抑郁症状 r = 0.11、0.13、0.17;另一元分析 r < − 0.01,仅限青少年子集时升至 r = − 0.07。

Orben & Przybylski (2019), The association between adolescent well-being and digital technology use, Nature Human Behaviour 3:173–182。经 Oxford ORA 取得作者接收稿全文(https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid:5d844350-a359-47d3-b10c-4bfb93ce613b)。Table 2 中位 β / partial η² 实测值:YRBS 完整规格曲线 −.035(.001),Electronic Device Use Only −.071,TV Use Only −.012(YRBS 无社媒测项);MTF 完整 −.005(<.001),Social Media Use Only −.031(.001);MCS 完整 −.032(.004),Hours of Social Media Use Only −.056(.009),Use of Internet at Home Only −.070,TV Weekday −.043。据此社媒/整体比值为 1.75×(MCS, β)、6.2×(MTF, β)、2.25×(MCS, η²)。

O&P 2019 摘要逐字确认证词所引两处:「…explaining at most 0.4% of the variation in well-being」与「Taking the broader context of the data into account suggests that these effects are too small to warrant policy change.」证词称「The relationships are equivalent to correlation coefficients less than r = .05」与 Table 2 三条完整规格曲线中位 β(−.035/−.005/−.032)相符。

O&P 2019 正文关于对照物的原文逐字:「the association of well-being with regularly eating potatoes was nearly as negative as the association with technology use (0.9x, YRBS) and wearing glasses was more negatively associated with well-being (1.5x, MCS)」——证实证词「potatoes 比较来自全体 digital media use 而非社媒专项」这一点成立(YRBS 确无社媒变量)。

反证(核心):Orben & Przybylski, 'Reply to: Underestimating digital media harm', Nature Human Behaviour 4:346–348 (2020), 开放获取 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7116236/。按 Twenge 等人偏好的分析选择重跑后逐字报告:「median association and effect size (β = - 0.051 [-0.072, -0.031], percent variance explained = 0.3% [0.2, 0.6])」,与原始 SCA(median β = − 0.032, 0.4%)无显著差异;「Wearing glasses was still more negatively associated with well-being in adolescents than digital technology use (βglasses = − 0.061 vs βtechnology = − 0.051)」;性别分层「females: median β = - 0.069 [-0.074, -0.065], males: median β = - 0.037 [-0.041, -0.032]」,并称技术使用「predicted nearly one half of one percent of the variability in the well-being of girls」。该 Reply 亦确认 Twenge 等人主张的是「six analytical decisions」。

Götz, F. M., Gosling, S. D., & Rentfrow, P. J., Small Effects: The Indispensable Foundation for a Cumulative Psychological Science。取得 CC-BY 接收稿全文(25 页,含完整参考文献),Semantic Scholar 标记 GREEN OA,链接 https://osf.io/hzrxf/download;PDF 元数据标题即「Preprint_Small Effects…Götz Gosling & Rentfrow 2020_Perspectives on Psychological Science.docx」。原文逐字:「the correlations between aspirin and prevention of heart attacks (r = .03; …); calcium intake and bone mass in premenopausal women (r = .08; Meyer et al., 2001), ibuprofen intake and pain alleviation (r = .14; Funder & Ozer, 2019; Meyer et al., 2001) or cardiac patient education and exercise (r = .09; Rosenthal & DiMatteo, 2001) are small to minimal, according to Cohen's classic guidelines (1988), but still highly consequential from a public health perspective.」全文 grep「lead」仅命中无关动词用法,无铅暴露例子。
Götz 原文另一处逐字(证词所引):「This phenomenon is especially true for effects that accumulate over time and at scale」——证词该引语成立。

Meyer, G. J., et al. (2001), Psychological Testing and Psychological Assessment: A Review of Evidence and Issues, American Psychologist 56(2):128–165。全文 PDF 已取得(https://gwern.net/doc/psychology/2001-meyer.pdf),Table 1 逐字核对:第 10 项「Calcium intake and bone mass in premenopausal women (Welten, Kemper, Post, & Van Staveren, 1995)」r = .08,N = 2,493;第 18 项「Extent of low-level lead exposure and reduced childhood IQ (Needleman & Gatsonis, 1990; effect size reflects a partial correlation correcting for other baseline characteristics that affect IQ scores [e.g., parental IQ], derived as the weighted effect across blood and tooth lead measurements reported in their Table 5)」r = .12,N = 3,210。

钙基准的更上游一手:Welten, Kemper, Post & Van Staveren (1995), A meta-analysis of the effect of calcium intake on bone mass in young and middle aged females and males, PMID 7472660——绝经前女性横断面研究中钙摄入×骨量偏相关 r = 0.08(95% CI 0.05–0.12),与 Meyer/Götz/证词三层一致。

旁证(Götz 例子清单未含铅):Primbs, Pennington, Lakens 等 (2023), 'Are Small Effects the Indispensable Foundation for a Cumulative Psychological Science? A Reply to Götz et al. (2022)', Perspectives on Psychological Science, 开放获取 https://pure.tue.nl/ws/portalfiles/portal/292873593/17456916221100420.pdf。该批评文逐条讨论 Götz 的医学类比时只处理阿司匹林(r = .03)等例,全文无铅-IQ 例子,与接收稿一致。

引用年份小差:证词记作「Gotz, Gosling, and Rentfrow (2020)」;该文 DOI 10.1177/1745691620984483,OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar 记 2021 年上线,正式期号为 Perspectives on Psychological Science 2022, 17(1):205–215。2020 与预印本年份相符,属可接受的引用惯例差异。
后续争议仍在进行、未见对该证词的正式勘误:Ferguson 的社媒减量 RCT 元分析(平均 d = .088)与 Haidt/Rausch 方的再分析(称最大 d = 0.17–0.20,女孩 d = 0.20)持续互驳,说明女孩专项效应量的量级至今未定于一尊。

证词 2.4 的 r = .15–.22 区间无从回溯到具体计算:该值为 Haidt 自陈 ballpark figure,所引三项研究(Kelly et al. 2019;Nesi & Prinstein 2015;Twenge 2020)本次未逐篇取回其女孩专项相关系数,故无法判定 .15–.22 是否可由这三篇复现,只能确认它不是这三篇中任何一篇直接给出的数字。
证词是否附有独立的利益冲突/Truth-in-Testimony 披露表未核:参议院此类表格通常与证词 PDF 分开归档,本次仅确认证词正文内无披露段落,未取得该场听证的 Truth-in-Testimony 表单。

corrections: (a) 证词 2.2 逐字 — 成立，无一字偏差。底稿引文与官方 PDF 完全一致（Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Technology, Privacy, and the Law, 2022-05-04, 'Teen Mental Health Is Plummeting, and Social Media is a Major Contributing Cause'，2.2 节起于 p.7）。仅补一处口径:证词 2.2 首段 Haidt 自己写 'Orben and Przybylski report that the average regression coefficient (using social media use to predict positive mental health) is negative but tiny'，与他两段后的更正（potatoes 比的是 all 'digital media use' 而非 social media）自相矛盾——同一节内先把 O&P 的构念说成 social media，再指责别人把它当 social media 读。

(a) '2 到 6 倍' — 修正前:'O&P 自己已发表的报告里，只看 social media 时关系比 digital media 大 2 到 6 倍'。修正后:按 O&P 2019 已发表 Table 2 的 β(即 Haidt 随后换算成 r 的那把尺子)，只有 MTF 一端接近 6 倍(Social media use only β=−0.031 vs Complete SCA β=−0.005 → 6.2×；vs Table 3 注中作为 potatoes/glasses 分母的'技术使用均值'β=−0.006 → 5.2×)；MCS 一端只有 1.75×(−0.056 vs −0.032)或 1.33×(vs −0.042)，两种分母下都**低于 2**。YRBS 根本没有 social media 变量(只有 electronic device use 与 TV use)，无法参与该比较。下界 2 只有改用 partial η²(平方尺度)才凑得出:MCS 0.009 vs 0.004 = 2.25×——但 η² 的倍数不等于 r 的倍数(η² 比 2.25 ≈ r 比 1.5)。故正确表述应为'约 1.3–1.8 倍(MCS)到约 5–6 倍(MTF)，取决于数据集与分母；下界 2 需混用平方尺度才成立'。

(a) 倍数 ≠ 量级(承重风险最高的一处) — 修正前:'六项分析决策掩盖了一个实际相当于 r≈.20 的关联'。修正后:即便全盘接受该倍数，O&P 自报的 social-media-only 系数仍是 β=−0.031(MTF, n=102,963)与 β=−0.056(MCS, n=7,972)，|r|≈.03–.06；O&P 正文对同一数字的原话是 'accounts for less than 0.1% of the observed variability in well-being'。r≈.20 比这高一个数量级，且该数字不出自 O&P 的报告，而出自 Haidt/Twenge 自行重跑的再分析。

(a) 一手反证 — O&P 2020 Reply(Nat Hum Behav 4:349–351)按 Twenge 等提出的全部 5 项修改(仅用验证过的量表、加入自伤结局、去掉争议控制变量、只留族裔控制、按性别分开)重跑 MCS 的 SCA，得 median β = −0.051 [−0.072, −0.031]、方差 0.3%(原始 SCA 为 β=−0.032、0.4%)，并写 'are not significantly different from those in our original SCA'；戴眼镜仍更负(β_glasses=−0.061 vs β_technology=−0.051)。**女生** median β = −0.069 [−0.074, −0.065]，男生 −0.037。即:六项决策被逐条采纳后既没逼近 r=.20，女生也没进入 .15–.22 区间。这与 Haidt 2.2/2.4 的核心推论直接冲突，写文章时必须并列呈现。

(c) Orben 2020 引语 — 逐字成立，但**被截断且被升格**。原文(Soc Psychiatry Psychiatr Epidemiol 55:407–414, p.409)确为 'The associations between social media use and well-being therefore range from about r = − 0.15 to r = − 0.10.'；但紧接下一句是 'It is, however, still unclear what such a small effect can tell us about well-being outcomes as social media use is inherently linked in complex ways with other aspects of life.' 且在 'Small negative associations between screens, social media and wellbeing' 小节 Orben 写:'...of about r = − 0.15 to r = − 0.10, while the correlations fall to about r = − 0.10 to r = − 0.05 in some work lauded as being more transparent [42, 43]'——[42,43] 正是 O&P 自己的工作。Haidt 只引前半、称之为 'Her own conclusion'，并据此给 2.3 起了 'emerging consensus' 的标题。修正后表述:该区间是 Orben 对既有(多为低质量横断)综述的汇总描述，她同段即指出更透明的研究降到 −0.10~−0.05，并保留'仍不清楚这么小的效应意味着什么'。

(d) 铅暴露 × IQ r=.11 — 修正前:'Götz/Gosling/Rentfrow 指出童年铅暴露与成人 IQ 的相关是 r=.11'。修正后:**Götz 等文中根本没有铅的例子**。预印本(OSF, 作者自存)与 SAGE 正式版全文(2023-05-21 Wayback 存档)逐字检索 'lead exposure'/'IQ' 均为零命中；其医学例子清单只有 aspirin r=.03、calcium intake × bone mass r=.08、ibuprofen r=.14、cardiac patient education × exercise r=.09。r≈.11–.12 的铅数据来自 Götz 所引的二手源 Meyer et al. (2001) American Psychologist 56:128–165, Table 1 第 18 条:'Extent of low-level lead exposure and reduced childhood IQ (Needleman & Gatsonis, 1990)'，**r = .12, N = 3,210**，且明确是 **childhood IQ** 而非成人 IQ，效应量是控制了父母 IQ 等基线特征后的偏相关。同表第 16 条 'Antihistamine use and reduced runny nose and sneezing' 恰为 r = .11。故三处偏差:数值(.11→.12)、结局构念(成人 IQ→童年 IQ)、归属层(Götz→Meyer 2001)。

(d) 钙 × 骨密度 r=.08 — 成立。Götz 正式版原文:'calcium intake and bone mass in premenopausal women (r = .08; Meyer et al., 2001)'；Meyer Table 1 第 10 条 r=.08, N=2,493 (Welten, Kemper, Post, & Van Staveren)。但 Haidt 附加的政策推论('which is enough to recommend that women take calcium supplements' / 'enough to justify a national campaign to remove lead from water supplies')是 Haidt 的话，不是 Götz 的:Götz 的原句止于 'are small to minimal, according to Cohen's (1988) classic guidelines, but still highly consequential from a public-health perspective.'

(d) 引用年份 — 修正前:'Gotz, Gosling, and Rentfrow (2020)'。修正后:Perspectives on Psychological Science, 2022, 17(1):205–215；first published online 2021-07-02。'2020' 可追到作者自存预印本文件名自标的年份(Preprint_...Götz Gosling & Rentfrow 2020_...docx, 2021-01-10 上传)，属可理解但仍应更正的书目错误。

(d) 转述边界 — 'in the domains of public health and education, many of the things that warrant public expenditure are correlated with outcomes in the ballpark of r = .05 to r = .15' 不是 Götz 原话(Haidt 未加引号，属概括；Götz 列出的实际区间是 .03–.14，且未使用 'warrant public expenditure' 这一表述)。反之 Haidt 加了引号的 'effects that accumulate over time and at scale' 是逐字的 ✓。

(b) 女孩 r=.15–.22 — 逐字成立(证词 2.4，标题在 p.7、正文在 p.8):'What would the correlation be if we could just look at girls? Several studies have found that it is substantially larger than for boys. See Kelly, Zilanawala, Booker, & Sacker (2019), Nesi & Prinstein (2015), and Twenge, J.M. (2020). I know of no study that has found a larger relationship for boys. A ballpark figure for the correlation just for girls is roughly r = .15 to r = .22.' 底稿省略号覆盖的正是那三条引证，无篡改。但需补两点口径:①证词内部漂移——2.3 标题与正文认同双性别合并为 r=.10–.15，2.2 却称 O&P 数据'实际相当于 r=.20'(同为双性别合并口径)，2.6 又改口辩护 '.15 到 .20'，四处数字互不自洽；②2.4 所引 'Kelly, Zilanawala, Booker, & Sacker (2019)' 实为 **2018**(EClinicalMedicine 6:59–68, 2018 年 12 月刊；Twenge 等自己 2020 年在 Nature 的参考文献里也标 2018)。
evidence_notes: Haidt 证词一手 PDF(官方参议院司法委员会域名)，已用 pdftotext 全文提取比对 2.2/2.3/2.4/2.6 四节:https://www.judiciary.senate.gov/imo/media/doc/Haidt%20Testimony.pdf 。抬头逐字:'Teen Mental Health Is Plummeting, and Social Media is a Major Contributing Cause / Testimony of Jonathan Haidt / Before the Senate Judiciary Committee, Subcommittee on Technology, Privacy, and the Law / May 4, 2022'。节标题逐字:2.2 'The correlation is much larger than for "eating potatoes" or "wearing glasses."'；2.3 'There is an emerging consensus that the correlation is in the ballpark of r = .10 to r = .15.'；2.4 'The correlations are larger for girls.'；2.6 'Correlations between .15 and .20 are not "small."'

O&P 2019 一手(Nature Hum Behav 3:173–182)含补充材料的作者版，Oxford ORA:https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid:5d844350-a359-47d3-b10c-4bfb93ce613b 。已发表 Table 2 逐格核到:YRBS Complete SCA β=−0.035/η²=0.001；MTF Complete SCA β=−0.005/η²<0.001，Social media use only β=−0.031/η²=0.001/n=102,963；MCS Complete SCA β=−0.032/η²=0.004，Hours of social media use only β=−0.056/η²=0.009/n=7,972。Table 3 注逐字:'For the YRBS the average effect linking technology to well-being was: β = -.049. For the MTF ... β = -.006. For the MCS ... β = -.042.'(此即 potatoes 0.86× / glasses 1.45× 的分母)。正文逐字:'social media use had a median negative association with well-being of β = −0.031 ... although the effect was small, suggesting that technology use operationalized in these terms accounts for less than 0.1% of the observed variability in well-being.'

O&P 2020 Reply 一手作者手稿(Europe PMC Funders / Oxford ORA):https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid:de333ddc-cc14-4d56-a7f4-bfd913e94cc8 与 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7116236/ 。逐字:'the median association and effect size (β = - 0.051 [-0.072, -0.031], percent variance explained = 0.3% [0.2, 0.6]) are not significantly different from those in our original SCA (median β = - 0.032, percent variance explained = 0.4%)'；'Wearing glasses was still more negatively associated with well-being in adolescents than digital technology use (βglasses = − 0.061 vs βtechnology = − 0.051)'；'females showed a more negative association than males (females: median β = - 0.069 [-0.074, -0.065], males: median β = - 0.037 [-0.041, -0.032])'。Methods 逐条列出所采纳的 Twenge 等 5 项请求。

Orben 2020 一手 CC-BY 正式版 PDF(Springer, Soc Psychiatry Psychiatr Epidemiol 55:407–414):https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s00127-019-01825-4.pdf 。p.409 逐字:'The associations between social media use and well-being therefore range from about r = − 0.15 to r = − 0.10. It is, however, still unclear what such a small effect can tell us about well-being outcomes as social media use is inherently linked in complex ways with other aspects of life.' 讨论节逐字:'Many studies and meta-analyses find a small negative association between social media use and well-being of about r = − 0.15 to r = − 0.10, while the correlations fall to about r = − 0.10 to r = − 0.05 in some work lauded as being more transparent [42, 43].'

Götz/Gosling/Rentfrow 两版都核过。作者自存预印本 PDF(OSF, CC-BY, 上传 2021-01-10，文件名自标 2020):https://osf.io/hzrxf/download 。正式版全文经 Wayback 存档核对:https://web.archive.org/web/20230521064258/https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/full/10.1177/1745691620984483 (页面自述 'Article first published online: July 2, 2021 / Issue published: January 2022 / Volume 17, Issue 1, Pages 205-215')。两版同一段逐字:'the correlations between aspirin and prevention of heart attacks (r = .03; ...), calcium intake and bone mass in premenopausal women (r = .08; Meyer et al., 2001), ibuprofen intake and pain alleviation (r = .14; Funder & Ozer, 2019; Meyer et al., 2001), or cardiac patient education and exercise (r = .09; Rosenthal & DiMatteo, 2001) are small to minimal, according to Cohen's (1988) classic guidelines, but still highly consequential from a public-health perspective.' 两版全文检索 'lead exposure'/'IQ' 均零命中。另 'effects that accumulate over time and at scale' 逐字存在 ✓。

Meyer et al. (2001) American Psychologist 56:128–165 全文 PDF(gwern 镜像):https://gwern.net/doc/psychology/2001-meyer.pdf 。Table 1 逐条核到:第 10 条 'Calcium intake and bone mass in premenopausal women (Welten, Kemper, Post, & Van Staveren...)' r=.08, N=2,493;第 16 条 'Antihistamine use and reduced runny nose and sneezing (D'Agostino et al., 1998)' r=.11, N=1,023;第 18 条 'Extent of low-level lead exposure and reduced childhood IQ (Needleman & Gatsonis, 1990; effect size reflects a partial correlation correcting for other baseline characteristics that affect IQ scores [e.g., parental IQ], derived as the weighted effect across blood and tooth lead)' r=.12, N=3,210。

Kelly 等文献年份经 CrossRef 一手核:DOI 10.1016/j.eclinm.2018.12.005，'Social Media Use and Adolescent Mental Health: Findings From the UK Millennium Cohort Study', EClinicalMedicine, published-print 2018-12, vol 6, pp. 59–68。证词写作 '(2019)'。

利益相关性:证词系立法听证的倡导性文件、非同行评审；Haidt 与 Twenge 均有以该论点为核心的畅销书(商业利益)；反向看 Orben/Przybylski 的学术声誉亦系于怀疑论一侧。三者均应在文中标明立场，不宜把任一方当中立裁判。另 Haidt 后续 Substack 文(afterbabel.com/p/why-some-researchers-think-im-wrong)对同一点已改用更弱的措辞 'the numbers are several times larger'，不再给出 '2 到 6 倍' 的具体区间，且明说 r≈.20 来自他与 Twenge 自己 're-ran Orben and Przybylski's code' 的再分析，而非 O&P 的报告。
unresolved: Twenge, Haidt, Joiner & Campbell (2020) 'Underestimating digital media harm', Nat Hum Behav 4:346–348 全文核不到一手。Unpaywall 查询该 DOI(10.1038/s41562-020-0839-4)返回空 OA 位置；Wayback 三次存档(2020-04-19/07-01/11-18)只保留摘要页、图注与参考文献(Fig. 2 题为 'Average linear r values between well-being and various factors in boys and girls from two datasets')；ORA/PMC/ResearchGate 均无全文(与其 Reply 不同，comment 未进 Europe PMC)。因此'between 2 and 6 times larger'这个具体倍数是否原样出现在该 comment、以及它采用的分母与度量(β 还是 partial η²、对照的是 Complete SCA 还是技术使用均值)无法一手确认。我的倍数复算全部直接取自 O&P 2019 已发表的 Table 2/Table 3——这正是 Haidt 所称的 'their own published report'，故复算结论本身仍是一手对一手。

Haidt 在 Substack 中所称他与 Twenge 're-ran Orben and Przybylski's code' 得到 r≈.20 的那份再分析，其完整规格(六项决策如何叠加、样本、结局变量、是否分性别)未见于任何公开可核的文件或补充材料;'六项分析决策'的逐条清单也只能从 O&P Reply 的 Methods 反推(该处只列出 5 项可在 MCS 实施的请求，第 6 项 MTF 小时制量表因 MCS 无对应测量未能实施)。
证词 2.4 为女孩 r=.15–.22 所引的另两条(Nesi & Prinstein 2015、Twenge 2020)未逐一回一手核其报告的 r 值——这三条的剂量/相关一手核对属 C24 组，本组只裁决引语逐字与 Götz/Orben 两个上游口径。
Götz 正式版全文只经 Wayback 单一存档核对(SAGE 原站需订阅、且对 WebFetch 返回的是站点框架页)。虽已与作者自存预印本交叉一致(两版该段文字相同、均无铅例)，但严格说'正式版无铅例'依赖的是一个镜像 + 一个作者版，未拿到出版商 PDF 原件。

corrections: (d) 归属错误 — 修正前:「Götz/Gosling/Rentfrow 2020 基准:钙摄入 r=.08、童年铅暴露×成人 IQ r=.11」→ 修正后:只有钙 r=.08 出自 Götz 等;铅×IQ r=.11 不在 Götz 文中。证词原文把两者分成两句,且 r=.11 的超链接指向 JAMA(Reuben et al. 2017, jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/fullarticle/2613157),该文 Table 2 报告童年血铅×成年 WAIS-IV 全量表 IQ 的 r = −0.11(Dunedin 队列)。把 r=.11 记在 Götz 名下是引用层的二次误植。

(d) 年份 — 修正前:「Götz/Gosling/Rentfrow 2020」→ 修正后:Perspectives on Psychological Science 2022;17(1):205–215(在线首发 2021-07-02, PMID 34213378)。证词自己也写成「Gotz, Gosling, and Rentfrow (2020)」,但其超链接指向 psycnet 记录 2022-26026-014。文章无 2020 年正式版。

(d) 构念 — 修正前:「钙摄入×绝经前女性骨密度(BMD)r=.08」→ 修正后:一手措辞是 bone mass(骨量)不是 bone mineral density:Götz 原文「calcium intake and bone mass in premenopausal women (r = .08; Meyer et al., 2001)」;该值可回溯到 Welten et al. 1995 meta 分析的偏相关 r=.08 [95% CI .05–.12]。

(d) 「r=.05 到 r=.15」区间 — 修正前:当作 Götz 的论断转述→ 修正后:这是 Haidt 的概括,Götz 原文没有给出该区间;Götz 列的实际值是阿司匹林×防心梗 r=.03、钙×骨量 .08、布洛芬×镇痛 .14、心脏病人教育×运动 .09、成长型思维 meta .08,其中 .03 低于 .05 下限。Götz 的原话是这些效应「small to minimal, according to Cohen's classic guidelines (1988), but still highly consequential from a public health perspective」。Haidt 引的「effects that accumulate over time and at scale」逐字成立。

(a) 「2 到 6 倍」的分子分母 — 修正前:笼统的「social media 比 digital media 大 2-6 倍」→ 修正后:回 O&P 2019 Table 2,该倍数是逐数据集算出且跨集混用的:MTF 中 social media use only 中位 β=−0.031 vs 完整 SCA −0.005 = 6.2×;MCS 中 hours of social media use only β=−0.056 vs 完整 SCA −0.032 = 1.75×(不是 2×);YRBS 根本没有 social-media-only 这一行(只有 electronic device use only −0.071 vs −0.035 = 2.0×)。所以「2 到 6 倍」是把 MCS 的 1.75 上取整到 2、MTF 的 6.2 下取整到 6 拼出的区间,方向成立但精度被修饰过。
(a) 倍数与 r=.20 的量级断裂 — 修正前:证词把「2-6 倍」和「r≈.20」并列呈现,读起来像前者支撑后者→ 修正后:2-6 倍作用在近零基线上,绝对值仍是 β=−0.031 到 −0.056(即 r≈.03–.06),比 r=.20 小一个数量级。二者不能互相支撑。

(a) 「6 项分析决策」的措辞 — 修正前:「6 analytical choices, each one defensible」→ 修正后:一手(Twenge, Haidt, Joiner & Campbell 2020, Nat Hum Behav 4:346–348,摘要段可在 nature.com 免费看到)的措辞是「Orben and Przybylski made six analytical decisions that resulted in lower effect sizes」。是 decisions 不是 choices,且原文没有「each one defensible」这一让步语——那是 Haidt 在证词里自己加的修辞。「published response paper in the same journal」这一点属实(确为 Nature Human Behaviour 的 Matters Arising)。

(a) 缺失的同刊反驳 — 修正前:证词只呈现 Twenge & Haidt 一侧→ 修正后:同期同刊 Orben & Przybylski (2020) Reply, Nat Hum Behav 4:349–351 已按评论方要求把六项决策全部反转重跑 MCS 的 SCA,结果中位 β = −0.051 [−0.072, −0.031]、解释方差 0.3%(原为 −0.032 / 0.4%),自述「not significantly different」;女生 median β = −0.069 [−0.074, −0.065],男生 −0.037。即反转六项决策得到的是 r≈.05–.07,不是 r≈.20。证词 2.2 未提及此 Reply。

(a) 2.2 小节标题被同一份 Reply 直接顶回 — 修正前:标题「The correlation is much larger than for 'eating potatoes' or 'wearing glasses'」→ 修正后:O&P Reply 在采纳全部修改后仍报告 β_glasses = −0.061 比 β_technology = −0.051 更负;O&P 2019 原文的比值也是马铃薯 ×0.86(YRBS)、眼镜 ×1.45(MCS)。「远大于眼镜」这一表述在一手证据上不成立(只有专门取 social-media-only 或女生子集时才可能反超)。

(c) 引语上下文被截断 — 修正前:只引「The associations…range from about r = − 0.15 to r = − 0.10」→ 修正后:Orben 2020 该句紧接着写「It is, however, still unclear what such a small effect can tell us about well-being outcomes…」(她自己称之为 such a small effect);同文另一处还写明「while the correlations fall to about r = − 0.10 to r = − 0.05 in some work lauded as being more transparent」。证词 2.3 的标题「emerging consensus…r = .10 to r = .15」略去了 Orben 给出的更低一档区间,也把一篇叙事性 review of reviews 的目测区间升格成了「consensus」。
(c) 该区间的合成方式 — 修正前:当作社媒×福祉的汇总相关→ 修正后:Orben 是把若干 review 报告的「社媒×抑郁症状 r = 0.11 / 0.13 / 0.17」与一篇 meta(总体 r < −0.01、仅青少年子集 r = −0.07)目测归并后写出的近似区间,构念跨了抑郁症状与 well-being 两类,不是同一构念的合并估计量。

(b) 无需改数但需补限定 — 修正前:「女孩 r≈.15-.22」作为共识数呈现→ 修正后:证词 2.4 逐字成立,但它只挂了三篇单研究(Kelly et al.、Nesi & Prinstein 2015、Twenge 2020),没有 meta 支撑;同期一手对照值明显更低:O&P 2020 Reply 的女生 median β = −0.069;Twenge/Haidt 自己 2022 年 Acta Psychologica 那篇 SCA 报的女生 median β 区间是 −0.11 到 −0.24(即 .15–.22 落在其中偏上段,且来自与 O&P 争议中的另一套分析选择)。
evidence_notes: 一手证词已取得并逐字比对:Haidt, "Teen Mental Health Is Plummeting, and Social Media is a Major Contributing Cause", Testimony before the Senate Judiciary Committee, Subcommittee on Technology, Privacy, and the Law, May 4, 2022 — https://www.judiciary.senate.gov/imo/media/doc/Haidt%20Testimony.pdf (12 页 PDF,已全文读取)。

(2020) "Teenagers, screens and social media: a narrative review of reviews and key studies", Soc Psychiatry Psychiatr Epidemiol 55:407–414, DOI 10.1007/s00127-019-01825-4(CC-BY,已下载 Springer OA PDF 并抽文)。p.409「Systematic reviews and meta-analyses: social media」小节原文:「The associations between social media use and well-being therefore range from about r = − 0.15 to r = − 0.10. It is, however, still unclear what such a small effect can tell us about well-being outcomes as social media use is inherently linked in complex ways with other aspects of life.」证词引语与前半句完全一致(含 therefore)。刊名/卷/页码 55:407-414 与论断所列一致。

(c) 同文另一处(小节「Small negative associations between screens, social media and wellbeing」)原文:「Many studies and meta-analyses find a small negative association between social media use and well-being of about r = − 0.15 to r = − 0.10, while the correlations fall to about r = − 0.10 to r = − 0.05 in some work lauded as being more transparent.」该区间的构成来源见同页上文:review 报告的社媒×抑郁症状 r = 0.11、0.13、0.17,以及一篇 meta 的 r < −0.01(仅青少年子集 r = −0.07)。Orben 全文摘要定调为「the association … is—on average—negative but very small」。

(d) Götz 一手全文已取得(作者接受稿,OSF https://osf.io/hzrxf/download,由 Semantic Scholar/Unpaywall 指向的 GREEN OA 版本)。原文:「the correlations between aspirin and prevention of heart attacks (r = .03; Rosnow & Rosenthal, 2003; …); calcium intake and bone mass in premenopausal women (r = .08; Meyer et al., 2001), ibuprofen intake and pain alleviation (r = .14; Funder & Ozer, 2019; Meyer et al., 2001) or cardiac patient education and exercise (r = .09; Rosenthal & DiMatteo, 2001) are small to minimal, according to Cohen's classic guidelines (1988), but still highly consequential from a public health perspective.」全文 grep 无任何 lead/铅暴露×IQ 的例子。另有「This phenomenon is especially true for effects that accumulate over time and at scale」——即证词所引短语,逐字成立。

(d) 铅×IQ 的真实出处已核到:证词该处超链接指向 https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/fullarticle/2613157,即 Reuben et al. (2017) JAMA,Table 2 报告童年血铅×38 岁 WAIS-IV 全量表 IQ 的 r = −0.11;主结果为每高 5 µg/dL 对应成年 IQ 低 1.61 分 [95% CI −2.48, −0.74]。样本为 Dunedin 单一出生队列,非汇总估计。
(d) 钙 r=.08 的原始出处链条:Götz 引 Meyer et al. (2001),该值可再回溯到 Welten et al. (1995) meta 分析(PMID 7472660),报告绝经前女性钙摄入×骨量偏相关 r=.08 [95% CI .05–.12]。

(d) 利益相关/后续争议:Götz 等的「小效应即重要」框架在同一刊物遭正式反驳 — Primbs, Pennington, Lakens, et al. (2023) "Are Small Effects the Indispensable Foundation for a Cumulative Psychological Science? A Reply to Götz et al. (2022)", Perspect Psychol Sci, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10018048/,主张跨领域基准类比无效除非有理论/实证论证(防弹衣例:「The effect size of wearing a bulletproof vest on the probability of dying is large if we examine people who get shot but very small if we include the millions of people who never get shot.」;并称「Categorizing r = .03 as small regardless of empirical context, discipline, study design, and outcome variable is…nonsensical」)。即证词 2.6 所倚的基准论本身在其原刊有对立文献。
